summary: Surface that frames related content, with optional header and footer slots.

usage.text: Padding defaults to none, so content touches the edge: set small, medium or large, or the --violet-card-padding custom property, which overrides every preset. Header and footer show only when filled.

The interactive attribute only adds tabindex="0", role="group" (unless a role is set) and hover and focus styling. It handles no keys and fires no event: add click and Enter/Space handling, or put a real button or link inside.

a11y.text: An interactive card is a group with no name of its own; give the host aria-label or aria-labelledby.
A non-interactive card adds no role; put a real heading element in the header slot when the card has a title.
